**UI AUDIT REPORT: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (SD Card View)**

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized, standard Windows 11 chrome).
*   **Title Bar:** [0, 0, 1024, 48]. Contains App Icon/Name (Left), Utility Icons (Center-Right), Window Controls (Right).
*   **Sidebar (Navigation):** [0, 48, 275, 944]. Vertical list with section headers and selectable items.
    *   *Reading Order:* Top-to-bottom. Sections: Data Recovery -> Advanced Features -> File Backup.
*   **Main Content Area:** [275, 48, 1024, 944]. White background.
    *   *Header Region:* [305, 95, 980, 250]. Title and descriptive text.
    *   *Hero Illustration:* [350, 290, 900, 670]. Central graphic.
    *   *Quick Target Cards (Row):* [280, 790, 980, 880]. Three distinct cards.
    *   *Status Bar / Notification Strip:* [280, 885, 980, 930]. Light purple background banner.
*   **Taskbar:** [0, 944, 1024, 768]. System taskbar at bottom.

### 2) TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** `Data Recovery`
*   **Sidebar - Item 1:** `Hardware Disk`
*   **Sidebar - Item 2:** `SD Card` (Selected)
*   **Sidebar - Item 3:** `More Recovery Tools`
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** `Advanced Features`
*   **Sidebar - Item 4:** `File Repair`
*   **Sidebar - Item 5:** `Lost Partition Rescue`
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** `File Backup`
*   **Sidebar - Item 6:** `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Heading:** `Connect Your Memory Card to Recover Lost Photos & Videos`
*   **Main Subtext:** `Connect your SD card to PC/Laptop with a card reader to recover the deleted, formatted and other lost photos and videos from cameras, UAV, dash cams and monitors, etc.`
*   **Card 1 Badge:** `SDR`
*   **Card 1 Title:** `Fix SD card access`
*   **Card 1 Desc:** `Repair SD card & restore access.`
*   **Card 2 Badge:** `SSR`
*   **Card 2 Title:** `Photos that open`
*   **Card 2 Desc:** `Rebuild fragmented photos.`
*   **Card 3 Badge:** `DVR`
*   **Card 3 Title:** `Video that play`
*   **Card 3 Desc:** `Reconstruct fragmented vid...` (Truncated)
*   **Status Banner Text:** `SD card connected but not detected? Show all external devices or Get Help`

### 3) COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Sidebar BG: `#F5F7FA` (ESTIMATED Light Gray/Blueish)
    *   Main Content BG: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Selected Sidebar Item: `#E6F0FF` (ESTIMATED Light Blue)
    *   Status Banner BG: `#F3EFFF` (ESTIMATED Pale Lavender/Purple)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Headings): `#1F1F1F` (Near Black)
    *   Secondary Text (Descriptions): `#666666` or `#555555` (Dark Gray)
    *   Selected Text: `#2B65D9` (Blue)
    *   Link Text (Banner): `#2B65D9` (Blue)
*   **Accents & Borders:**
    *   Selection Indicator (Left border): `#2B65D9` (Blue, ~3px width)
    *   Success Checkmark: `#22C55E` (Green)
    *   Card Badges (SDR, SSR, DVR): Background `#E6F0FF`, Text `#2B65D9`

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Main Heading:** Sans-Serif (likely Segoe UI/Inter), ~24px, Weight 600 (Semi-Bold).
*   **Body Text:** Sans-Serif, ~13-14px, Weight 400 (Regular), Line height ~1.5.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Sans-Serif, ~13-14px, Weight 500 (Medium).
*   **Section Headers:** Sans-Serif, ~12px, Weight 600, Color Gray.
*   **Card Titles:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Weight 600.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~275px.
*   **Sidebar Item Height:** ~48px.
*   **Sidebar Padding Left:** ~24px (text start).
*   **Main Content Padding:** ~40px from left edge of content area, ~30px top.
*   **Card Dimensions:** Width ~200px, Height ~80px. Gap between cards ~20px.
*   **Icon Size (Sidebar):** 24x24px.
*   **Icon Size (Cards):** 32x32px or 40x40px.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Sidebar selection: 0px (sharp) or slight 2-4px.
    *   Status Banner: 6-8px.
    *   Card Badges: 4px (rounded rectangle).

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Window Controls (Top Right):**
    *   Minimize (Dash icon): Normal state.
    *   Maximize (Square icon): Normal state (indicates window is currently maximized).
    *   Close (X icon): Normal state.
*   **Sidebar List Items:**
    *   `Hardware Disk`: Normal. Has a **Success Indicator** (Green checkmark circle on the right).
    *   `SD Card`: **Selected State**. Indicated by light blue background fill and a thick blue vertical bar on the left edge.
    *   `More Recovery Tools`, etc.: Normal/Disabled (grayed out text implies inactive or category header behavior, though looks clickable).
*   **Quick Target Cards:**
    *   State: Normal/Hoverable. No visible click state in screenshot.
    *   Anatomy: Icon (Left) + Text Block (Right). Badge above title.
*   **Status Banner:**
    *   Contains interactive text links (`Show all external devices`, `Get Help`).

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, "Filled" style (solid shapes), modern, slightly rounded corners on geometric shapes. Uses a limited color palette (Blues, Grays, Oranges, Purples).
*   **Sidebar Icons:**
    *   Hardware Disk: Grid of squares (blue/gray).
    *   SD Card: SD Card shape (blue).
    *   More Tools: Wrench/Screwdriver cross (gray).
    *   File Repair: Folder with tool/magic wand (gray).
    *   Lost Partition: Globe/Target (gray).
    *   ChronoSnap: Circular arrows (gray).
*   **Header Icons (Top Right):**
    *   Avatar/User (Blue background).
    *   Cart/Shopping bag (Orange/Yellow).
    *   Gift box (Orange).
    *   Info 'i' (Gray).
    *   Hamburger Menu (Gray lines).
*   **Card Icons:**
    *   Fix SD: Drive/SD symbol (Blue).
    *   Photos: Broken image/File icon (Orange).
    *   Video: Play button/Puzzle piece (Purple/Pink).
*   **Hero Illustration:** Complex vector illustration containing:
    *   Drone (White/Gray).
    *   Desktop PC Tower (Gray).
    *   Monitor (Blue screen with USB cable icon).
    *   Camera (White/Black).
    *   Action Cam (White/Black).
    *   Mascot Character (Robot/Alien in lab coat, holding SD card).

### 8) STATE
*   **Page Level State:** **Empty / Waiting for Input (Instructional)**.
    *   The application is waiting for the user to connect a storage device.
    *   It is not "Loading" (no spinners on the main heading, though there is a small spinner icon next to the main title "Videos", suggesting a background check or live status update might be occurring).
    *   The banner at the bottom indicates a specific sub-state: **"Connected but not detected"** or general help prompt.
*   **Motion Cues:**
    *   A small loading spinner (circle arc) is visible immediately after the word "Videos" in the main heading, suggesting the UI is polling for device changes.
